lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: is there anything that you long to obtain?
Not really.
Loads.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: It would appear material objects hold no sway over you.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: If that's the case, you probably won't grasp what I'm getting at...
Oh, no. There're loads of things I want to have as well.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: What if it's prohibitively expensive?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Would you still lust after it?
If it's that pricey, I might have to think twice about it.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Hmmm...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: What if you wanted it so badly

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: that you couldn't eat

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: or sleep?
If it was that bad, then I would bite the bullet and buy it.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Very good.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I believe I made the right decision.
What did you buy?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: A shield?
A shield? Oh, you're talking about a game?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: My main character is a tank.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: In order to maximize my efficiency while minimizing movement,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: this purchase was essential.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: It's a rare item that doesn't often appear on auction.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: With this shield, our guild's bound to become unstoppable,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: and I'll serve an even more vital role amongst the team!
You're going to extreme lengths to justify this purchase. Just how expensive was it?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Er...
How bad could it be?
Well, there's nothing necessarily wrong with spending money on something you like.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: After buying this shield,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I don't have any credits left.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: My electricity and water have been cut too.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I even had to

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: dip into our squad's petty cash.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm positive Guillotine even posted something about me online:

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Corrupted roses should be left to wither.
You may have gone too far in a few places...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I simply wanted to contribute more to the team.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: To make that happen, I figured the money wasn't even a concern.
How are you going to get by now?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: now that you brought it up...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: could you lend me some credits by any chance?
Maiden? Your messages aren't showing up for some reason.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Commander?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Commander????
I think I should avoid Maiden for a while.
